name: Nigrescent-Hamada
description: Rolling continents break around shallow seas, their interiors scored by tectonic rift valleys. Beyond magnetic pole anomalies, the land runs to a horizon that feels hand-drawn.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Fossil beds suggest rich seas once flourished here; now the chemistry records only a slow suffocation.
research outpost was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
